description: Львівська обласна державна адміністрація: gas datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Львівська обласна державна адміністрація. Coverage: Львівська обласна державна адміністрація. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about gas; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Дані про споживання комунальних послуг (електрична енергія, теплова ен; Дані про споживання комунальних послуг (електрична енергія, природний . Formats seen: CSV, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution, License not specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
